1058: pub open spec fn LogRangeMatchesQueue<DT: Dispatch>(
1059:     queue: Seq<ReqId>,
1060:     log: Map<LogIdx, LogEntry<DT>>,
1061:     queueIndex: nat,
1062:     logIndexLower: LogIdx,
1063:     logIndexUpper: LogIdx,
1064:     nodeId: NodeId,
1065:     updates: Map<ReqId, UpdateState<DT>>,
1066: ) -> bool {
1067:     recommends([0 <= queueIndex <= queue.len(), LogContainsEntriesUpToHere(log, logIndexUpper)]);
1068:     decreases_when(logIndexLower <= logIndexUpper);
1069:     decreases(logIndexUpper - logIndexLower);
1070:     &&& (logIndexLower == logIndexUpper ==> queueIndex
1071:         == queue.len())
1072: 
1073:     &&& (logIndexLower < logIndexUpper ==> {
1074:         &&& log.contains_key(
1075:             logIndexLower,
1076:         )
1077: 
1078:         &&& (log.index(logIndexLower).node_id == nodeId ==> {
1079:             &&& queueIndex < queue.len()
1080:             &&& updates.contains_key(queue.index(queueIndex as int))
1081:             &&& updates.index(queue.index(queueIndex as int)).is_Placed()
1082:             &&& updates.index(queue.index(queueIndex as int)).get_Placed_idx() == logIndexLower
1083:             &&& LogRangeMatchesQueue(
1084:                 queue,
1085:                 log,
1086:                 queueIndex + 1,
1087:                 logIndexLower + 1,
1088:                 logIndexUpper,
1089:                 nodeId,
1090:                 updates,
1091:             )
1092:         })
1093: 
1094:         &&& (log.index(logIndexLower).node_id != nodeId ==> LogRangeMatchesQueue(
1095:             queue,
1096:             log,
1097:             queueIndex,
1098:             logIndexLower + 1,
1099:             logIndexUpper,
1100:             nodeId,
1101:             updates,
1102:         ))
1103:     })
1104: }
